scope: Built-in Git service and search; synthetic local-only fixtures. UI startup, rendering, watchers, remote/network and system-Git backend are excluded.
method: Fresh service and empty caches per iteration; repeated calls use the same service; OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Median uses middle/average; p95 is nearest rank. Memory values are process observations, not memory caps.

fixtures.cache_state: fresh service per iteration; same OS filesystem cache; first sample is first process access

search_budgets.memory_scope: Default-budget query cache is dropped before full-budget cache construction; process memory includes these workloads serially and harness allocations.

memory.scope: Whole standalone service benchmark process, including serial default-budget/full-budget search workloads and harness/results. Default content index dropped before full-budget allocation. Excludes fixture creation, Git CLI, Cargo and GPUI.
